description: Class representing single criterion in a color scale conditional formatting rule.

GetColor.description: Returns the format color of the color scale criterion.

returns.description: An ApiColor object representing the criterion's color, or `null` if no color is set.

GetIndex.description: Returns the index indicating which threshold the criterion represents.

returns.description: Returns 0 for minimum threshold, 1 for midpoint (3-color scale) or maximum (2-color scale), and 2 for maximum threshold (3-color scale only).

GetType.description: Returns the type of the color scale criterion.

returns.description: The type of the color scale criterion.

GetValue.description: Returns the value of the color scale criterion.

returns.description: The value of the color scale criterion, or `null` if not set.

SetColor.description: Sets the format color for the color scale criterion.

params.description: The ApiColor object specifying the color.
params.name: oColor

SetType.description: Sets the type for the color scale criterion.

params.description: The type of the color scale criterion.
params.name: type

SetValue.description: Sets the value for the color scale criterion.

params.description: The value of the color scale criterion.
params.name: value
